# Anthropic Managed Agents — multiagent orchestration + workflow runs (literal config facts)
# Captured 2026-10-11 from
#   https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/multiagent-orchestration
#   https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/workflow-runs
# NOTE: store LITERAL field names / defaults / event names here, never a prose summary.

multiagent.type = "multiagent_20261001"   (supersedes the older "coordinator" type)

DEFAULTS under multiagent_20261001:
  subagents                      enabled
  subagents.predefined_agents    []          (empty)
  subagents.inline_agents        enabled
  workflows                      enabled
  workflows.predefined_agents    []          (empty)
  workflows.inline_agents        enabled
  advisor                        disabled    ({"type":"enabled","model":"<id>"} to turn on)

RULES:
  - sending null to `workflows` or `subagents` TURNS IT ON (default is enabled)
  - inline_agents {"type":"disabled"} requires >=1 entry in that list's predefined_agents, else 400
  - the two predefined_agents lists are SEPARATE; up to 20 unique agents EACH
  - an agent that itself has `multiagent` set cannot be listed in another agent's lists
  - {"type":"self"} lists the agent itself; reads back as its own id + version
  - "You can't limit an inline agent" to a declared set of MCP servers
  - with a `limited` environment, session create 400s if the agent or any listed agent declares
    an MCP server host not in allowed_hosts; environment networking allow_mcp_servers:true
    turns that check off

WORKFLOW RUN
  started by: model judgment from user.message text. NO API CALL.
  stopped by: asking the agent in a user.message; or archiving the session. NO API CALL.
  permission policies apply to a run's agents' TOOLS, not to starting the run.
  run threads are EXEMPT from the session child-thread limit.
  a paused run does not keep the session running; its lifetime keeps passing while paused.

  states:  running | idle | ended
  result types: completed | stopped | program_error | thread_limit_error | timeout_error
                | unknown_error

  event types (session event stream):
    workflow_run.created          (carries run name + `phases`)
    workflow_run.status_running
    workflow_run.phase_started
    workflow_run.status_ended     (carries `result`)
